record.name: Platform
record.purpose: The standards this group works to.

says: alice binds her checkout of the repository, registers a repository-authored source whose home cites that binding, and commits two revisions of it, the second expecting the head the first moved to. The Team platform registers a managed source of its own and commits one revision. The repository and Team Instructions positions each select their source at an exact revision. Every answer must keep, for each source, the one home it was registered with, one revision owner (its own scope's commits, each on the head before it) and, for the repository source, the repository binding its home cites. The session start composed from both positions names each unit with its own source and the exact revision its position pinned (the repository's second revision, the Team's first) and the layer it belongs to, and resolving an exact member of the repository revision returns that same stored revision. Nothing here re-homes a source, commits one source's revision under another's owner, or reads a source through a binding it does not have.
